title: Mixed loot tables
description: This data pack will mix up all the loot in Minecraft!
body:
This data pack will mix up all the loot in Minecraft! Now, zombies can drop loot from the Ancient City, while the Bastion can drop loot from the door (the door itself), and you can fish for loot from the Palace of Trials. This can make progression easier or more challenging, and will also force you to explore loot in a new way.

It differs from Mixed Loot Entities/Chests in that loot is mixed together, like entities between entities, and chests between chests. In this case, loot is mixed between chests, blocks, entities, etc.

Loot will vary depending on the data pack version. Also, some blocks/chests/entities, etc., may not have loot because they may have been mixed with objects that didn't originally have loot.

[Video](https://youtu.be/2vFE5VC0kKA)
